findings.desc: Timeout stop reasons regress to provider_unhealthy for real host subprocess timeouts. main classified /timeout|timed out/ as AutopilotStopReason timeout before budget/validation fallback; this branch calls classifyAutopilotProviderFailure before the timeout branch in packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1217-1220. The new classifier treats any "timeout"/"timed out" text as retryable network_unreachable in packages/main/src/core/autopilot-reliability.ts:95-96. Real Claude subprocess failures emit warning text "claude-code real subprocess timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms" from packages/main/src/core/lattice-dispatch.ts:2377-2386, and auto.status===failed builds the classification message from warnings plus nextAction in packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:1654-1658, so this existing timeout contract now becomes status paused_requires_resume with stopReason provider_unhealthy instead of failed/timeout. Read-only probe confirmed classifyAutopilotProviderFailure("timed out after 1000ms") returns network_unreachable/retryableProviderHealth=true.
